newsitem.title: ST VINCENT: CRICKET-SRI LANKA WIN TOSS, WEST INDIES BAT IN 2ND TEST.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SRI LANKA WIN TOSS, WEST INDIES BAT IN 2ND TEST.

text.p: Sri Lanka won the toss and put West Indies in to bat on the opening day of the second and final test at Arnos Vale on Friday.
West Indies - Courtney Walsh (captain), Sherwin Campbell, Stuart Williams, Floyd Reifer, Brian Lara, Carl Hooper, Roland Holder, Courtney Browne, Ian Bishop, Curtly Ambrose, Franklyn Rose.

Sri Lanka - Arjuna Ranatunga (captain), Sanath Jayasuriya, Roshan Mahanama, Marvan Atapattu, Aravinda de Silva, Sanjeeva Ranatunga, Romesh Kaluwitharana, Kumara Dharmasena, Sajeeva de Silva, Ravindra Pushpakumara, Muttiah Muralitharan.
